annotations.text:
Both artboards match what is live in the Quarix site (app/page.tsx, components/pricing.tsx), on the site's own tokens: #f7f7f4 background, #1f1f1f text, #6f6f6f muted, Geist, and the gradient pill button. Dark mode is handled by the site's theme toggle, so these boards show the light theme only.

Motion: on the site GSAP runs the hero on load and the pricing cards on scroll into view. These boards use the CSS equivalent - the artboard sandbox cannot load GSAP - so reload to replay.

Open items:
- The face in the founder card is a drawn placeholder.
- Book an intro call has no scheduling link yet; every pricing CTA opens mail to hello@quarix.com.
